Subject: Inquiry from illustrator GEGYjiji — watercolor zine / consignment possibility

Dear UTRECHT team,

I have long admired how UTRECHT brings together artist books, zines, and illustrated works that sit quietly between fine art and everyday life, and I think my work may belong in that same conversation. I am GEGYjiji, a Chinese watercolor artist based in Tokyo, and in 2021 I published Colour Diary, a small illustration collection grown from a daily watercolor practice that documents domestic interiors, neighborhood light, and the quiet texture of city life — much of it observed here in Tokyo. My work has been shown in Tokyo most recently as part of Tide from China, a group exhibition at ACG_Labo in Harajuku in 2023, and I am now looking to place printed work or original pieces in spaces where that kind of attentive, intimate scale feels at home. I would love to explore whether a consignment arrangement or a small exhibition might be a possibility, and you are welcome to see more of my work on Instagram at @gegyjiji. Thank you very much for your time, and I hope to hear from you.

GEGYjiji

GEGYjiji

Subject: Consignment Inquiry — Colour Diary / GEGYjiji

Dear B&B team,

I have long admired how your shelves bring together books, zines, and art in a way that feels genuinely curated rather than simply stocked, and Shimokitazawa feels like the right neighborhood for the kind of quiet, observational work I make. I am GEGYjiji, a Tokyo-based Chinese watercolor artist, and I am writing to ask whether B&B accepts consignment inquiries for self-published artist books. My first illustration collection, Colour Diary, grew out of a daily watercolor diary practice I began in 2020 — it documents domestic interiors, neighborhood light, and small moments of urban life in a format I think would sit naturally alongside the books you carry. You can find a fuller sense of my work on Instagram at @gegyjiji. I would love to hear about your current process for consignment, and I am also happy to visit the shop in person if that would be easier.

Warm regards,
GEGYjiji

B&Bさんは、本とビールという組み合わせが象徴するように、読む・見る・集うという行為をひとつの場所で丁寧に成立させているお店だと認識しており、そのような空間にご連絡させていただきました。私はGEGYjiji（ジェジー）と申します。中国・湖南省出身で、現在東京を拠点に活動している水彩イラストレーターです。2020年から毎日水彩画を描く「diary」という個人連作を続けており、その積み重ねから生まれた初のイラスト集『Colour Diary』（2021年10月刊行）について、B&Bさんへの委託販売のご相談ができればと思いご連絡しました。作品は赤い壁、路地、プール、緑の池といったごく普通の日常の風景を題材にしており、見慣れた街角や公園をそぞろ歩くような感覚を水彩でお届けできればと考えています。作品の詳細はInstagram @gegyjiji にてご覧いただけますので、ご関心をお持ちいただけましたら、ぜひお話しする機会をいただけますと幸いです。

Subject: Consignment inquiry — Colour Diary (illustration collection) by GEGYjiji

Dear COW BOOKS team,

I admire how carefully your Nakameguro shop is curated — the sense that every book on the shelf has been chosen by someone who actually reads, which is rare and matters to me as both a reader and an artist. The work focuses on quiet Tokyo interiors, neighborhood light, cats, and the particular way a city looks when you are still learning to belong to it — themes I think might sit naturally alongside the books you already carry. You can see my recent work on Instagram at @gegyjiji, and I am happy to bring a copy of the book in person if a visit would be easier than corresponding by email. Thank you sincerely for your time, and I hope to hear from you.

GEGYjiji

Subject: Booth Application Inquiry — ZINEフェス東京 July 11 2026

Hi BOOK CULTURE CLUB team,

I've been following ZINEフェス東京 for a while and really appreciate that it centers self-made work in an intimate, browse-at-your-own-pace format — which feels like exactly the right setting for what I make. I'm GEGYjiji, a Chinese watercolor artist based in Tokyo, and I'd love to apply for a half-table booth at the July 11 event; I published my first illustration collection, Colour Diary, in 2021, growing directly from a daily watercolor diary practice I've kept since 2020, and I'd be bringing printed zines and small works from that ongoing project. GEGYjiji
